verdict.rationale: The RTX 5090 ships with a developer ecosystem (CUDA Toolkit, SDKs), so an interactive API reference is a fair question for this product. However, nothing in the evidence shows an interactive reference or runnable examples. The CUDA Toolkit docs describe compilers, libraries and tools, not an explorable reference. The probe found no OpenAPI spec at any candidate path. An llms.txt file exists, but it is a different capability and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
